spanish: No la cambiará, y no la mudará, bueno en malo o malo en bueno; y si mudando mudare bestia en bestia, y será ella y su mudanza santidad.

findings.issue: Object clitic is feminine (la); both object suffixes are 3rd masculine singular.
ella is feminine; the pronoun and the suffix on the exchange-noun are 3rd masculine singular.
Two verbs of being are smoothed into a single será.
en narrows the preposition ב toward into; with cambiar/mudar it can be read as transformation rather than exchange-for.

notes: Exchange verbs, good/bad, beast, and קדש as santidad stay within the tokens; gender of the 3ms referents does not.
